visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Let the Library Sort
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A hand-written bubble sort orders the words by length. Use Arrays.sort with an anonymous Comparator. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Describing only how two items compare lets the library's sorting algorithm do the rest, and it is faster than a hand-written bubble sort. The comparison rule is now separate from the sorting mechanics.
